subject: Social Media
title: The Influencer Industrial Complex
description: One-minute skill: The Influencer Industrial Complex.

hook.text: Behind every influencer: a manager, a talent agency, a brand deal team, and a content strategist.

buildup.text: Influencer marketing agencies now rival traditional ad firms. They broker deals, manage brands, and track ROI.

discovery.text: The industry professionalized fast. Rate cards, media kits, engagement audits—influencing is now corporate.

twist.text: Many influencers feel trapped. What started as creative expression became content production under contract.

climax.text: The industrial complex rewards consistency over creativity. Post daily or the algorithm forgets you.

punchline.text: The hobby became a job. The job became a grind.

quiz.question: What do influencer marketing agencies do?
options: Broker brand deals and manage influencer business operations
